description:
Pre-close gate for bl-f1c5. After all phases merge, verify on main:
- cargo test passes (workspace-wide).
- cargo tarpaulin --fail-under 100 passes.
- End-to-end demo from the epic Done-when runs green: a prompt that emits two parallel dispatch tool_use blocks produces two sibling subagent branches off the parent's tool-call commit, both subagents run their multi-step loops, both merge back, await(handle) retrieves their compacted summaries, parent merges to main.
- Recursive case: a subagent that itself dispatches a sub-subagent (3 levels of hyphenated descent) runs and merges cleanly.
- Stop case: a stopped subagent leaves the parent's await(handle) resolving to a stopped status, parent continues without hanging.
Close when all four checks green.
title: Gate: tests pass (v0.4 epic)
